1.explanation: The accessibility violations originate from the AccordionSkeleton and AccordionSkeletonItem functions (in Accordion.Skeleton.js) and the ButtonSkeleton component (in Button.Skeleton.js). Each of these functional components outputs a form control element (<button> or <a role="button">) with no inner text or aria-label attribute, causing DAP to report missing labels. To fix this, these components must provide an accessible label (for example, via an aria-label prop or by including visually hidden text) on each skeleton button.

2.explanation: The accessibility tool reports that each form control element (buttons in the AccordionSkeleton and AccordionSkeletonItem, and the anchor with role="button" in ButtonSkeleton) has no associated label. The key functions render these unlabeled controls and must be updated to include an aria-label or visible label element to satisfy the accessibility requirement.
2.bug_scenario: The Accordion and Button skeleton components render interactive form controls (<button> elements in AccordionSkeleton and AccordionSkeletonItem, and <a role="button"> or <div> in ButtonSkeleton) without any visible or aria-accessible label. DAP flags each of these controls as missing an associated label, causing an accessibility violation.
